title: Pilot files operations
description: How the saving feature's records reach the disk.

entities.name: Read a record
entities.description: The text stored under a pilot name.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call; SimHost (through FlyInSystem's save and load) and the tests call it.
failures: None for a name no record may hold, a missing file or folder, or an unreadable file.

entities.name: Write a record
entities.description: Stores a record under a pilot name, replacing any record there.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call; SimHost (through FlyInSystem's save and load) and the tests call it.
entities.result: The file is written through a .partial file renamed into place; the folder is made first.
failures: A failed write is dropped: the trait cannot report it, and the file is left as it was.

entities.name: List the records
entities.description: The pilot names that have a record file.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process call; SimHost (through FlyInSystem's save and load) and the tests call it.
entities.result: The names, sorted; other files are ignored.
failures: A missing folder has no names.

relatedViews.relationship: The saving feature whose store this is.
